title: Beyond Quadratic Loss: The Stability Phase Diagram of Adam
read_scope: Abstract, introduction, Section 3, Appendix C.1-C.2, period-detection description B.2; not an exhaustive audit of every proof or cited paper.
finding: Adam memory-parameter phase diagrams and quadratic-loss oscillations are already studied. The quadratic baseline uses 250000 updates with 125000 discarded and threshold crossings to estimate a macroscopic period. Appendix C varies curvature, learning rate and epsilon. These diagnostics differ from full derivative spectra. The superquadratic right-boundary result treats n>2 with epsilon and bias factors neglected. No tanh-Yogi map or matching hyperchaotic regime was identified in the sections inspected. This is not a non-equivalence or priority certificate.
